=== a CP/M program at its load address, labels without colons
bdos    equ 5
        org 100h
start   ld de,msg
        ld c,9
        call bdos
        ret
msg     db 'Hello, world',13,10,'$'
=== a ROM with its vectors, org padding between pieces
        org 0
        di
        jp reset
        org 38h
isr     ex af,af'
        exx
        exx
        ex af,af'
        ei
        reti
reset   ld sp,0
        im 1
        ei
halt1   halt
        jr halt1
=== the location counter
        org 8000h
        jr $
        djnz $+2
        ld hl,$
        dw $, $+1
        jp $+3
=== the undocumented shift
        sll b
        sll (hl)
        sll (ix+5)
=== the accumulator left implicit
        add b
        adc (hl)
        sbc 12h
        add (ix+1)
=== data directives
        org 4000h
        db 1,2,"ab"
        defb $ff
        defm "xy"
        dw 1234h,label
        defw 1
        ds 2
        defs 2,$aa
label   db 0
=== undocumented OUT (C),0
        out (c),0
=== a macro with positional arguments, repeats and conditionals
load    macro
        ld a,\1
        ld (\2),a
        endm
        load 1,$4000
        load $ff,1234h
        rept 2
        nop
        endr
        if 0
        halt
        else
        scf
        endif
